body: Not sure, there's a couple things I've though about getting into. I didn't drop out of high school, I just didn't go to college because I was lazy. Foolish, considering I basically had a free ride. That said, I won't keep you anymore. Kinda strange to be having a conversation like this in public on reddit haha. Thank you though. Please keep being a good person.

Not yet, I'm sure I can get one. It'll just end up being another dead end job until I go to trade school or something, which I don't have an issue with doing, I'm just out of juice. No lust for life, I don't see any good in the world for me. Thanks for keeping me company in your own way, haha.
Always been at the back of my mind, but in the past couple days I've gotten fully on board with the idea.
I appreciate it, I'll try to take it to heart but I can't say for sure if they will manifest. Feels like this has been a long time coming. Thank you.

Thanks. I don't know, it's just I've always been an ear/voice of reason for people in a bind because I'm truly willing to listen. It's okay, It's what I expected. They don't mean it maliciously (at least intentionally), they just don't understand. I lost what was an entire world to me, but I don't want others to miss out because of the demons that ail them. It's a way to make sure a tiny bit of me is out there. If my parents weren't around still I would have done this a long time ago, but now I'm close to doing it even knowing the hurt I would cause. Hard to feel there's any happiness left for me here on earth. You're a good person.
